titulo: Authorities release Nancy Guthrie ransom note in search for new leads | Hanomansing Tonight
cuerpo: Investigators have released the full ransom note and a follow-up letter tied to the disappearance of Today Show host Savannah Guthrie's mom, who was abducted from her home in Arizona six months ago. Authorities are looking to the public in hopes the writing style in the notes will help generate new leads in the investigation.
